mapper.select: SELECT L.LOCATIONID AS LOC_ID, L.LOCATIONNAME AS LOC_NAME, WH.WAREHOUSETYPE AS LOC_TYPE, L.STATUS AS LOC_STATUS, WH.WAREHOUSENAME AS WAREHOUSE, WHA.AREANAME AS WHAREA, R.RACKNAME AS RACK FROM LOCATION L JOIN RACK R ON L.RACKID = R.RACKID JOIN WAREHOUSEAREA WHA ON R.AREAID = WHA.AREAID JOIN WAREHOUSE WH ON WHA.WAREHOUSEID = WH.WAREHOUSEID WHERE R.RACKNAME = #{rack,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY L.LOCATIONNAME

select * from ( SELECT L.LOCATIONID AS LOC_ID, L.LOCATIONNAME AS LOC_NAME, WH.WAREHOUSETYPE AS LOC_TYPE, L.STATUS AS LOC_STATUS, WH.WAREHOUSENAME AS WAREHOUSE, WHA.AREANAME AS WHAREA, R.RACKNAME AS RACK FROM LOCATION L JOIN RACK R ON L.RACKID = R.RACKID JOIN WAREHOUSEAREA WHA ON R.AREAID = WHA.AREAID JOIN WAREHOUSE WH ON WHA.WAREHOUSEID = WH.WAREHOUSEID WHERE R.RACKNAME = #{rack,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from UPN U LEFT JOIN STEP S ON U.CURRENTSTEPID = S.STEPID where U.LOCATIONID = L.LOCATIONID and U.REMAININGQTY > 0 and U.STATE IN ('ACTIVE', 'HOLD', 'NG') and S.DESCRIPTION IN ('SMT线边仓站') ) ORDER BY L.LOCATIONNAME ) where ROWNUM <= 50
